=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py: lines 104-105, line 99 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The check-runs fetch uses `per_page=100` without pagination, so failing check-runs beyond the first page are invisible to the stuck detector.
  WHY: A PR with more than 100 check runs can remain indefinitely in an open, non-failing state and never trigger stuck recovery; severity was NIT in deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and qwen_qwen3_7-plus, but MAJOR in google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, so the highest severity is used.
- .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py: line 116 `_parse_time(commit["commit"]["committer"]["date"])` and line 180 `except (ReadError, KeyError, TypeError, ValueError)` | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A null or otherwise invalid committer date can cause `_parse_time` to raise `AttributeError`, which is not caught by the exception handler.
  WHY: The script can emit a traceback and exit incorrectly instead of producing the expected JSON error with exit 2, breaking the checker's re-arm contract; severity was NIT in deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2, but MAJOR in google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and qwen_qwen3_7-plus, so the highest severity is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
